And last two weeks ago, a little less than two weeks ago, MDE came out with a format for filling out a continuity of learning plan. The administrative team and I worked directly with teachers basically in a pyramiding process. Leaders from each grade level and each department were invited to be a part of the discussion. They took notes from those discussions and communicated with people in their grade levels or in their departments, came back to the administration, and we formulated actually two things at the same time. We're trying to be careful with just figuring out how much the family load can handle in terms of adding this to their plate.
